shorts_extract.hook: Volunteers cramped inside a roaring MRI tube told a nervous patient 'the scanner is super comfortable' — and their brain's conflict spike predicted how much they convinced themselves it was true.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Van Veen, Krug, Schooler & Carter (2009 Nature Neuroscience): 45-min loud MRI task, free-choice intercom fib vs paid-bonus control, dACC + anterior insula BOLD predicting attitude shift.
shorts_extract.twist: Settled the 40-year Festinger vs self-perception debate: dissonance physically fires visceral gut discomfort (insula) + error conflict (dACC) in real time during the fib.
